edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive a Base Salary of $250,000 per year, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, plus benefits.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive without cause, the Executive shall receive a Severance Amount equal to six months of Base Salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices.

4. NON-COMPETE. For six months after termination of employment, the Executive shall not perform duties substantially similar to those performed for the Company for a business that directly competes with the Company’s products or services in any geographic area in which the Executive had material responsibilities during the final twelve months of employment.
